mapper.select: SELECT token_id, user_id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM kakao_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kakao_token (user_id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accessToken}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiresAt}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_token = VALUES(access_token), refresh_token = VALUES(refresh_token), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = VALUES(created_nm), del_yn = 'N'
